name: Original Notification 18
definition: Identifies the original notification, to which the cancellation advice refers.

OriginalMessageIdentification.name: Original Message Identification
OriginalMessageIdentification.definition: Point to point reference, as assigned by the original sender, to unambiguously identify the original notification to receive message.

OriginalCreationDateTime.name: Original Creation Date Time
OriginalCreationDateTime.definition: Date and time at which the original message was created.

NotificationCancellation.name: Notification Cancellation
NotificationCancellation.definition: Indicates whether the cancellation applies to the complete original notification or to individual items within the original notification.

OriginalNotificationReference.name: Original Notification Reference
OriginalNotificationReference.definition: Identifies the original notification item, to which the cancellation advice refers.
